notes.text: A route change around an obstruction must be shown on a revised drawing before the pipe is modified.
If the obstruction is 300 mm wide or less along the original centerline, the change may be recorded on the as-built drawing instead.

conditions.question: How wide is the duct, measured along the original pipe centerline?

notes.text: Rerouted NPS 1 to NPS 2 pipe needs at least 75 mm clearance to the obstruction.
Install a hanger within 900 mm of each fitting added to a relocated branch line.
